scientific_integrity: The original Apéry-set and Frobenius results are credited to their authors; the proposed additional contribution is the isolated-gap digit box and its exact quotient-stratum distribution. Proof uses the established Apéry theorem, not undisclosed independent certification.
scientific_limitations: Only increment parameter one, b>=2, n>=3.
Dimension two is covered by prior specialized work.
The full Smith (2022) article was not accessible; potential implicit coverage is a residual originality risk.
Finite verification is not a proof of the infinite domain.
Independent review and validation have not been performed.
title: Exact isolated-gap box and digit distribution for unit-shift generalized repunit semigroups
